author: Eddie Makuch
description:
A new report sheds more details on Microsoft's plans for new Xbox hardware, including a new handheld device and console, and one of the biggest takeaways is the alleged price.

According to Fortune, the Project Helix console could cost between $1,200 and $1,800, unless Microsoft opts to subsidize the cost. The system could launch in 2028, the report said.

It's not uncommon for platform-holders to eat some of the cost of a new console and make up the difference with
title: Next-Gen Xbox Could Be $1,800 And Launch In 2028 – Report

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
After a year that featured alternate realities, ninja turtles, superheroes, and hobbits, the final Magic: The Gathering expansion of 2026 is going where no Universes Beyond set has gone before, as Star Trek is scheduled to launch in November.

Today, Wizards of the Coast revealed the mechanics players can expect in the set, along with dozens of new cards from both the main set and the preconstructed Commander decks. We also got a glimpse at some of the set's special treatments, including the seven cards that will come signed by the people depicted on the artwork.

Here's everything revealed during today's Magic: The Gathering Star Trek debut.
title: Here Are The Mechanics and Dozens Of New Cards From Magic: The Gathering’s Star Trek Set

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Sony isn't the only company introducing new upscaling technology to its flagship PlayStation 5, as Microsoft and AMD have announced that FSR 4.1 is coming to more devices--including Xbox Series X|S consoles--in the future.

Similar to Sony's hardware-accelerated upscaling solutions for PS5 and PS5 Pro, AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) 4.1 is an advanced, machine-learning-based temporal image upscaling and reconstruction technology that can render a game at a lower resolution and then upscale it to a higher resolution.

While it's highly doubtful that Xbox Series X|S consoles will start offering PS5 Pro-like graphics (both consoles lack dedicated hardware for machine-learning algorithms), this should still give owners a noticeable bump in graphical quality and performance if implemented properly.

"At Xbox, we're building a gaming platform desi
title: Xbox Series X|S Is Getting A Surprise Graphics Boost From AMD

author: Steve Watts
description:
Stupid Never Dies makes a strong, if extremely weird, first impression. Wrapping roguelite progression around the system of an action-RPG and setting that story in an inventive punk-inspired world of monsters is an inviting hook. Plus, it's hard not to feel some affection for the dimwitted hero and his undoubtedly creepy quest to revive the supposed love of his afterlife. But the inventive world and a few neat ideas can only carry this game so far, and I ultimately struggled to look past the repetitive and often imprecise combat. 

The world of Stupid Never Dies has been completely taken over by monsters who emerged from inside the Earth's crust. These monsters are very conspicuously inspired by classic silver screen incarnations and popular B-movies, all filtered through a '90s or '00s pop-punk aesthetic. It's a stylish blend of influences that immediately identifies this game's goofball, self-effacing tone.
title: This Character-Action Zombie Game Stumbles Into Its Own Way

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick and Sony's top boss, Hiroki Totoki, commented on the future of gaming today at the Paley International Summit. Naturally, the topic of AI came up, and Totoki believes AI technologies will not replace humans in game development, in part because of the creativity required.

"Creativity is for humans, not AI,” Totoki said, as reported by IGN. “How to use the technology profile is important. Of course, I encourage my people to use AI in a certain manner, but at [the] same time we try to keep the rights and rights holders and
title: PlayStation Boss: “Creativity Is For Humans, Not AI”

author: Chris Compendio
description:
It's now been a full decade since Nintendo announced the first Switch, which is almost hard to believe, given how fresh that reveal trailer still feels in our heads. Heaps of hype and a lack of information from Nintendo about its Wii U successor, codenamed "NX," led to the company's fanbase becoming increasingly restless.

Reports and rumors pointed to the NX as a console-handheld hybrid, but Nintendo didn't fully unveil the Switch until October 20, 2016 (an announcement preluded by a photo of Mario being a creep). The three-and-a-half-minute video made it clear how Nintendo wanted players to interact with the Switch, showi
title: 10 Years After The Switch 1 Reveal, I Still Haven’t Played A Game At A Rooftop Party

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Right on schedule, the second wave of games coming to Xbox Game Pass has been revealed. Following the first batch that included Gears of War: E-Day, Battlefield 6, and lots more, the rest of the month will see games like Final Fantasy 7 Remake and The Seance of Blake Manor added to the subscription service. We've also gotten a sneak peek at what's coming in November, so there's going to be plenty to play over the next couple of weeks.

As a reminder, several games are also leaving Xbox Game Pass this month, including a pair of Double Fine classics and one massive Star Wars Lego game.

Xbox Game Pass October Wave 2 Games

October 21

  • Sand
title: Xbox Game Pass’s Newest Wave Is Headlined By A Huge Final Fantasy Adventure

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
Earlier this year, a new trading card game based on the hit Cyberpunk franchise hit Kickstarter and became the highest-funded game in Kickstarter's entire history. With the launch set now out in the wild, WeirdCo is ready to announce the game's first expansion, Edgerunners: Burn Bright, which is scheduled to launch in Spring 2027.

Edgerunners: Burn Bright will introduce multiple characters, locations, and moments from the popular Netflix anime into the card game, along with new mechanics which will be revealed closer to the set's release date. The set will also introduce a new chase rarity, though WeirdCo did not share further details.

We have an exclusive reveal of the artwork for one of the characters joining the Cyberpunk TCG through the Edgerunners: Burn Bright set,
title: Here’s An Exclusive Look At How Cyberpunk: Edgerunners’ Cast Will Look In The Hit Trading Card Game

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Netflix has undertaken efforts over the years to increase its footprint in the world of video games, but it's been a bumpy road, and new data suggests that the company is falling short of its targets.

According to a Netflix memo seen by The Wall Street Journal, only 3.5% of Netflix's subscribers play games monthly. That's 10% behind Netflix's 2026 target for "reach and engagement" for games, the memo said. In 2022, it was reported that
title: Netflix’s Push Into Gaming Continues To Fall Short

author: Dave Irwin
description:
Those familiar with the Castlevania games know that the series has a history of hiding multiple endings. After all, Symphony of the Night had an entire castle flipped upside down, hidden behind a series of items locked away in hard-to-reach areas. Subsequent games also had entire areas that were only accessible if you equipped certain items at the right time.

Castlevania: Belmont's Curse continues this trend, so if you want to know more about the requirements for unlocking this metroidvania game's best ending, we have the full checklist of things you need to do. On top of that, we'll explain exactly what getting these items unlocks and the potential pitfalls you may encount
title: All Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse Endings Explained

author: Dave Irwin
description:
As you explore the Library in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, you may have noticed rings of glyphs you can bounce off, surrounding spheres with one of three designs. These are planetary spheres, each depicting a figure representing the constellation you need to trace with the glyphs to unlock a larger glyph that bounces you high in the sky.

Now, you can hunt for these constellations in the form of clues left behind in the various rooms of the Library. If you're searching for all the weapons, you probably should take that approach. However, if you only want the combos for each one of the
title: How To Solve The Star Chart Puzzles In Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
While a whole bunch of new games are being added to the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog this month, it looks like Sony is making room for them by removing several titles over the next few weeks. We don’t know exactly when they will be gone, but you can expect 11 games to be removed over the next couple of weeks, including two of Rockstar's biggest open-world adventures: Red Dead Redemption 2 and Grand Theft Auto 5.

We've known for a while that GTA 5 was on its way out, but it looks like Rocksta
title: GTA 5 And Red Dead Redemption 2 Are Leaving PS Plus, But You Still Have Time

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 doesn't just look visually impressive; it also has a killer sound thanks to French electronic music duo Justice. Composing the soundtrack for any game is no easy feat, but with GTA 6 generating an unprecedented amount of hype, the team of Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay are well aware of the expectations that have been placed on them.

"Yeah, we are aware of the hype of the game, of course, and the fact that people have been waiting for such a long time," Augé said in an interview with the BBC 1 radio show (via NINE1NINE). "On the other hand, we are aware, and we see this colossus approaching, and at the same time we see it a bit from the outside. So it was a good way for us also not to let these thoughts come into our minds and not intrude on our
title: Justice Is Keeping The GTA 6 Hype At Arm’s Length While Making Its Soundtrack

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Fortnite's spooky season content is rolling out, and that includes the character Nikki from one of 2026's biggest movies, Obsession.

Inde Navarrette's character from the Curry Barker movie is coming to Fortnite on October 21. As expected, Nikki's "No, no, no!" line from the movie is coming to Fortnite as an emote, but not in the way you might expect. Instead of Nikki voicing the line, she holds out cue cards with the words on them. Check out the video below to see how the emote looks in the game.

Additionally, Nikki in Fortnite can change her face to replicate the character's iconic frown from the movie. The DLC bundle also includes a One-Wish Willow as a pickaxe and a broken wine bottle for a we
title: Fortnite’s Obsession DLC Leaks, Includes A Twist On The Movie’s Iconic Line

author: Eddie Makuch
description: Activision recently released ports of 2010's Call of Duty: Black Ops and 2012's Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 on PlayStation, and they were massive hits. According to a report, the games combined to sell more than 11 million copies on PS4 and PS5. Developer Gavin Goslin, who worked on these games at Treyarch, has reflected on the massive success of these ports and why it feels "bittersweet."
title: “The Suits” Made All The Money From Call Of Duty: Black Ops 1 And 2 Ports, OG Dev Says

author: Heidi Kemps
description:
It's not often that a live-service game gets any sort of attention after the servers have shut down, but there was something special about Final Fantasy: Brave Exvius. It was more than just a mediocre gacha-based RPG with Final Fantasy branding slapped on it--it featured a fully original story with unique characters, a fully fleshed-out setting, and plenty of that unmistakable Final Fantasy flavor. So when Square-Enix announced Final Fantasy Resonance--a full-fledged single-player remake of part of Brave Exvius's story--there was excitement. Former Brave Exvius players could revisit the setting they loved, and those who hadn't played could enjoy the story without all of the gacha baggage.

Retooling a live-service, gacha-monetized game into a single-player experience is no easy task, however, but Square-Enix clearly felt that the legacy of Brave Exvius was worth the effort. And while Final Fantasy Resonance succeeds adm
title: Final Fantasy Resonance Saves A Great Story From Live-Service Oblivion

author: Richard Li
description: As both a remake and a standalone experience, Final Fantasy Resonance shines more than it stumbles. And while Final Fantasy Resonance succeeds admirably in retelling the saga of Rain and the battle against the Veritas, it does have a handful of shortcomings that keep it from becoming the next great Final Fantasy epic.
title: Final Fantasy Resonance Saves A Great Story From Live-Service Oblivion | Review

author: Kurt Indovina
description:
If Nintendo Switch Sports Resort's sole mission is to make you look and feel stupid and have a ton of fun with friends and family, then Nintendo has accomplished that mission with flying colors (and flailing arms). Considering Nintendo's other outings with its motion-controlled sports games, that shouldn't come as a surprise--nor should the feeling of a sore arm the next morning: a feeling that I consider nostalgic at this point.

Switch Sports Resort delivers the best showcase of sports and modes, making it feel like a complete experience and the most cohesive package in the series to date.

For the nostalgic-driven players, it's easy to notice which sports from previous games aren't included among the 12 here, like Chambara, Badminton, and Disc Golf. But in place of those missing games are what I consider to be the greatest hits of the series, joined by welcome additions like the te
title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Is The Best Entry In The Series

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
GTA 6 launches in November, and everyone expects it to be a giant, record-breaking release. But just how big will the release be? Early signs are pointing to an enormous, unprecedented launch, and new data backs that up.

Sensor Tower compiled preorder data for some of the biggest games released over the past six years, including Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2022), Diablo 4 (2023), Hogwarts Legacy (2023), and Marvel's Spider-Man (2023).

The analysis firm found, <
title: GTA 6 Is 148% Ahead Of This Other Popular AAA Game So Far

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
As Cyberpunk 2077's sixth anniversary approaches, developer CD Projekt Red has announced Update 2.5, timed to coincide with the second season of the anime spin-off series, Cyberpunk Edgerunners. The update will include "new items and features" inspired by the second season of the anime, and it'll go live on October 22 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.

"We're talking cyberware customization, a new dual-wielding playstyle, and more," CD Projekt Red wrote in a social media post. Fans can tune in on Wednesday for a livestream preview of Update 2.5 at 8 AM PT / 11 AM ET. Cyberpunk 2 associate game director Pawel Sasko posted that he's "so f***ing hyped" to show people what the studio has been working on, suggesting that there'll be some substantial content to look f
title: Cyberpunk 2077 Is Celebrating Edgerunners Season 2 With A Surprise Update

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
With Grand Theft Auto VI set to launch on November 19, fans are still waiting for Rockstar to reveal the actors behind Jason Duval, Lucia Caminos, and the many other characters who inhabit Leonida. The developer has shared character profiles, trailers, and extended footage, giving fans plenty of dialogue to analyze, but it's kept most of its voice cast under wraps. One major name has now publicly confirmed his involvement, but other actors are linked to the game through fan theories, online credits, and comparisons between their voices and the characters shown in trailers.

There's been plenty of speculation, including theories about a pair of relatively unfamiliar names playing the protagonists. A key theory about Troy Baker p
title: GTA 6 Voice Actors – All Confirmed And Rumored Cast

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season Two once again sees Studio Trigger handle animation duties, and this time, the anime powerhouse has gotten even wilder with its depiction of Night City and its residents. While the first season was bold in its visual direction, director Kai Ikarashi has pushed it even further, using more abstract shapes and experimental animation techniques to capture the look and feel of a cutting-edge dystopia.

What does that lead to? A new season that showrunner Bartosz Sztybor calls a shift from Michael Bay-directed movies to Martin Scorsese-inspired (absolute) cinema.

"I t
title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2 Is More Punk Rock Than Blockbuster

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: Amid all the violence and cool cyborg technology, the first season of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is a tragic love story at its core. But in the second season? It might be more punk-rock, following a new cast of characters around Night City, but according to showrunner Bartosz Sztybor, emotional themes of love and parenthood are the connective tissue between seasons.
title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2 Mirrors The First Season, But With One Major Difference

author: Callum Self
description:
Sometimes, there’s simply an offer that’s too good to pass up. The Mafia Trilogy, for all intents and purposes, delivers three excellent action-adventure games, and even the third entry--which received a more mixed reception than Mafia and Mafia 2--is a pretty fun time. With around 50 hours of narrative content to enjoy, an 83% discount makes this an absolute bargain. It also gives you a great excuse to finally pick up Mafia: The Old Country.

Playing through all three Mafia games is like watching a TV crime drama, except you get to experience it yourself. Mafia follows Tommy Angelo, a hard-working cab driver during Prohibition. After a run-in with the mob, he ends up working for the Salieri crime family amid a good old-fashioned turf war between two rival families. The promise of riches beyond Tommy’s wildest drea
title: The Mafia Trilogy Has Hit Its Lowest Price, And You’d Be A Fool To Refuse

description:
While you don't need this Arcana to finish Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, getting the best ending does require you to meet a bunch of cryptic requirements. One is the Judge Arcana card, which is relatively simple to finish on paper, but you may need to backtrack to some difficult puzzles throughout Dracula's castle.

This is because you will need certain upgrades found mostly in optional platforming puzzle areas where you need proficiency with the use of skills such as the Arcane Whip, dashing, double-jumping, and Holy Light skills to get the reward. Of course, you may also find one of the many relics or
title: How To Pass The Judge’s Test In Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse

description:
Once Human is steering toward the launch of Isles of Abyss, and with the expansion comes new Morphed Deviations to find and add to your collection. Deviations continue to work the same as usual, acting as entities that provide a myriad of benefits in combat, crafting, and exploration. Morphed Deviations are unique variants that are only available as part of seasonal events or when big updates take place.

Isles of Abyss introduces multiple new Morphed Deviations, as well as a new Deviation altogether. The latter features an ability suits one of the prominent mechanics in the expansion, related to weather conditions that greatly affect the environment of the islands.

title: How To Get The New Morphed Deviations In Once Human: Isles of Abyss

author: Diego Nicolás Argüello
description:
Once Human is introducing a brand new expansion, called Isles of Abyss, which features a plethora of mechanics and features. These include Haywire Zones, which are specific areas across the map affected by environmental crises.

Haywire Zones are essentially weather conditions that can take place at random around the islands in the new map. If you're unprepared to defend yourself from each of their properties, you'll have a harder time navigating places of interest and cruising on your ship. Considering how hostile enemies both water and land can be in the expansion, it's key to know how these zones work, and what to bring with you.

If you're wondering how to best navigate the environmental crises of the new expansion, here's how to survive Haywire Zones in Once Human: Isles of Abyss to best suit yourself for t
title: How To Survive Haywire Zones In Once Human: Isles Of Abyss

author: Diego Nicolás Argüello
description:
Once Human is firing on all cylinders with Isles of Abyss, a massive update that presents a separate scenario for the free-to-play shooter. While developer Starry Studio has released multiple updates since Once Human's launch in mid-2024, the latest can be considered an expansion of sorts, with an oceanic archipelago leading to an assortment of features and mechanics being introduced for the first time.

Isles of Abyss takes the foundation of the base Once Human experience and expands it with some key differences. Namely, you can now create your own ship and set sail to traverse multiple islands, each with its own enemies, resources, and hazardous weather. And that's without mentioning the community-led aspect and how the entire scenario is divided into two phases. Yes, there's a lot to take into account.

title: Everything New In The Once Human Isles Of Abyss Scenario
